correctness.rationale: Exact rank probabilities give the covariance entry classes and hence C=(I+B^T B)/12. The complete-graph incidence identity yields Q^2=nQ for Q=B^T B, proving the proposed inverse by direct multiplication. The same identity gives the two eigenvalue multiplicities and determinant. Equal precision diagonals then give the stated least-squares full-order partial correlations.
